title: PLSsemLab: A jamovi Module for Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling

creators.name: Chacón Chacón, Arquímedes De León
creators.affiliation: Universidad Católica Andrés Bello (UCAB), Caracas, Venezuela

description: An open-source jamovi module that brings partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) to jamovi with the cSEM R package: models built from boxes, PLS and consistent PLS, reliability and validity (HTMT with bootstrap intervals), structural model with blockwise bootstrap, higher-order constructs, two-way interactions with simple slopes and Johnson-Neyman, overall model fit by bootstrap (SRMR, d_G, d_L), PLSpredict, CVPAT, mediation, IPMA and multigroup analysis (MICOM, Henseler and Chin tests). Every result is paired with evidence-based methodological guidance, interpretation and educational support in English and Spanish.
